title: Fix malformed block parsing in reference pipelines
message: Malformed or truncated blocks could contaminate following tables, and mismatched replacement indices could raise StopIteration. Recover completed text independently of bad coordinates, preserve raw fragments, and isolate malformed pages and crops. Validated with 10 regression tests, a matched 2,078-page replay, and fresh single/double/triple inference on 16 pages using one H100.

title: Refresh quick20/full500 release predictions and table-aware regression scoring
message: Refresh 20+500 raw predictions from released Parse 3.5 weights and update reference metrics, coverage, expected results and hashes. Apply released Table-body HTML conversion in layout_lite v3; preserve historical raw scoring through --table-mode legacy. Document measured runtime deviation, retained capped/malformed outputs, and exact reproduction scope.
